purpose: General principle against over-engineering: a gate limiting when speculative or catastrophic-failure defenses, or unfounded improvements, may be adopted, using a three-point check.
summary: Purpose: unbounded defensive measures bloat systems and hide real errors
Gate applies only to three types of findings, not to fix decisions in general
Three types: catastrophic external causes, speculative rare defenses, unfounded quality improvements
Findings exempt from the check: requirement or rule violations, concrete runtime risks, data loss and security
Being found in review is not grounds to skip
Out of scope: OS-level failures, filesystem corruption, disk exhaustion, hardware failure
Three-point check: other premises already broken, independent safety nets, cost versus prevented harm
When unclear whether a type applies, treat as normal fix target
When check items are unclear, skip or create_issue with rationale
tasks: Evaluating review findings for fix versus skip
title: 比例性の原則（過剰設計の抑止）
